# Part 02 · Transformer Block

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DcGhURzxKby/) · Published 16 Aug 2026

> What happens to a sentence inside one transformer block?

Attention lets words share context. On its own it can't store facts, and a deep stack of it loses the original meaning on the way through.

## The idea

- Words become embedding vectors, with position tags so the order survives.
- Each block runs attention (words share context), then a feed-forward network (each token looks up stored facts on its own).
- Skip connections carry the original vector around each step, so the meaning isn't erased.

## The formula

$$
X_1 = X + \text{MHSA}(\text{LN}(X)), \quad X_2 = X_1 + \text{FFN}(\text{LN}(X_1))
$$
